programme.title: Report
programme.desc: Tedenska predstavitev vsebin iz lokalnega okolja. Voditeljica Špela Pokeržnik gosti športnike, glasbenike, politike in vodje društev. Znižati socialno pomoč – toda za koliko? Leta 2027 naj bi bila uvedena – po vsej Avstriji enotna socialna pomoč. S tem naj bi se naredil konec dosedanji razdrobljenosti različnih pravil po zveznih deželah. Ministrstvo za socialne zadeve je zdaj predložilo prvi osnutek, ki sledi načelu denar v zameno za udejstvovanje: tistim, ki se ne integrirajo ali se izogibajo trgu dela, grozijo občutna znižanja. Odločilno vprašanje, v kakšni višini naj bi bila ta znižanja, pa v tripartitni koaliciji še ni dokončno izpogajano. Čas se izteka in prve zvezne dežele že nasprotujejo. Ali je cilj enotne socialne pomoči sploh v interesu dežel? In ali so veljavna stroga pravila posameznih deželnih vlad res pripeljala več ljudi do zaposlitve? Argumente zbirata Ulla Kramar-Schmid in Barbara Krivanek. Prazne reke, draga zima: avstrijske hidroelektrarne so osrednji steber domače proizvodnje električne energije – v običajnih letih se več kot polovica elektrike proizvede z vodo. Vendar letošnje leto ni običajno. Hidroenergija je v krizi. Padavin je odločno premalo – in to že od začetka leta. Proizvodnja elektrike v hidroelektrarnah je zato upadla za približno 30 odstotkov. V Spodnji Avstriji številne manjše hidroelektrarne zaradi pomanjkanja vode že več tednov sploh ne obratujejo. Posledica: Avstrija mora uvoziti več elektrike iz sosednjih držav. In to je lahko drago, opozarjajo strokovnjaki. Kakšne nauke morata iz tega leta potegniti politika in upravljavci elektrarn? Temu vprašanju sta se posvetila Yilmaz Gülüm in Sabina Riedl. Nevidna nevarnost: naj bo v jutranji žemlji, paradižniku ali kozarcu vina – v naši hrani je danes že povsod mogoče najti večne kemikalije, kot je na primer trifluorocetna kislina, s kratico TFA. Količina večnih kemikalij pa še naprej narašča, kot kaže analiza podatkov ministrstva za okolje, ki sta jo opravili organizacija Global 2000 in Univerza na Dunaju. Zaskrbljujoče pri tem: samo med letoma 2018 in 2024 se je obremenitev s TFA v podtalnici potrojila. Kako nevarne so večne kemikalije za okolje in zdravje, kdo je odgovoren za to povečanje in ali ministrstvo za okolje ter kmetijstvo te nevarnosti jemlje dovolj resno?

The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Clap de fin sur le championnat du monde de motocross en Australie, sur le circuit d'Hidden Valley, à Darwin. En MX2, le titre se joue entre l'Espagnol Guillem Farrés (Triumph), le Belge Sacha Coenen (KTM) et le Sud-Africain Camden McLellan (Triumph). Qui va succéder au palmarès à l'Allemand Simon Längenfelder ?

programme.title: Australie | MXGP - Course 2
programme.desc: Direction Hidden Valley's pour la manche finale de la saison 2026.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Le grand favori du contre-la-montre Elite messieurs des championnats du monde de Montréal 2026 est le Belge Remco Evenepoel, en quête d'un nouveau sacre après ses trois titres consécutifs, de 2023 à 2025. Ses principaux adversaires seront l'Italien Filippo Ganna, le Britannique Joshua Tarling et le Suisse Stefan Küng. Côté français, on espère un podium pour Rémi Cavagna ou Bruno Armirail.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Suivez les Championnats du monde de cyclisme sur route. Ces championnats fondés en 1921 déterminent le champion et la championne du monde de cyclisme sur route dans plusieurs catégories : le cyclisme sur route (hommes, femmes, moins de 23 ans et juniors), le contre-la-montre (hommes, femmes, moins de 23 ans et juniors) et le contre-la-montre par équipes en relai mixte.

programme.title: Soldier Hollow | Cross-country Olympique (H)
programme.desc: Place à la 8e manche de la saison 2026 aux États-Unis. Suivez l'épreuve sur Eurosport.n

programme.title: Bol d'Or | Course - 1re partie
programme.desc: Le Bol d'Or 2026 se déroule sur le circuit Paul Ricard, au Castellet et constitue la grande finale du championnat du monde d'Endurance Moto (FIM EWC).

programme.title: Endurance : 6 Heures de Spa-Francorchamps
programme.desc: Après Imola, direction le circuit de Spa-Francorchamps pour la deuxième épreuve du Championnat du monde d'endurance FIA 2026. L'an dernier, la Ferrari AF Corse #51 s'était imposée en Belgique, avec le Britannique James Calado et les Italiens Antonio Giovinazzi et Alessandro Pier Guidi. A un peu plus d'un mois des 24 Heures du Mans, le rendez-vous de Spa-Francorchamps s'annonce crucial.

programme.title: Mark Selby - Noppon Saengkham
programme.desc: Le 16 août dernier à Taiyuan, Mark Selby est devenu le premier joueur à remporter l'Open de Chine à quatre reprises, après ses victoires en 2015, 2017 et 2018. Grâce à quadruplé, le joueur de Leicester remontait à la 5e place mondiale. Son adversaire malheureux en finale, le Thaïlandais Noppon Saengkham, grimpait quant à lui au 27e rang.

programme.title: Bol d'Or | Course - 1re partie
programme.desc: Le Bol d'Or 2026 se déroule sur le circuit Paul Ricard, au Castellet et constitue la grande finale du championnat du monde d'Endurance Moto (FIM EWC).

programme.title: Snooker : Wuhan Open
programme.desc: Le joueur chinois de 37 ans Xiao Guodong, actuel n°11 mondial, est le double tenant du titre de l'Open de Wuhan. L'an dernier, il avait remporté le tournoi pour la deuxième année consécutive en battant l'Anglais Gary Wilson (10-9), au terme d'une finale à suspense. L'année précédente, Xiao avait décroché son premier titre classé en s'imposant (10-7) face à Si Jiahui, lors d'une finale 100 % chinoise.

programme.title: Kyren Wilson - Judd Trump
programme.desc: Le numéro 8 mondial, l'Anglais Kyren Wilson, remet son titre en jeu à Shanghai. L'an dernier, il s'était imposé en finale face à son compatriote Ali Carter (11-9). Il succédait ainsi au palmarès du tournoi chinois à l'actuel numéro un mondial, Judd Trump, vainqueur en 2024. La légende Ronnie O'Sullivan est le joueur le plus titré à Shanghai. Il a remporté les Masters à cinq reprises (en 2009, 2017, 2018, 2019 et 2023).

A un peu plus d'un mois des 24 Heures du Mans, le rendez-vous de Spa-Francorchamps s'annonce crucial.

programme.title: Kyren Wilson - Judd Trump
programme.desc: Le numéro 8 mondial, l'Anglais Kyren Wilson, remet son titre en jeu à Shanghai. L'an dernier, il s'était imposé en finale face à son compatriote Ali Carter (11-9). Il succédait ainsi au palmarès du tournoi chinois à l'actuel numéro un mondial, Judd Trump, vainqueur en 2024. La légende Ronnie O'Sullivan est le joueur le plus titré à Shanghai. Il a remporté les Masters à cinq reprises (en 2009, 2017, 2018, 2019 et 2023).

programme.title: 30 for 30: The New York Sack Exchange
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Los Angeles Sparks vs. Las Vegas Aces
Kyren Wilson - Judd Trump
programme.desc: Le numéro 8 mondial, l'Anglais Kyren Wilson, remet son titre en jeu à Shanghai. L'an dernier, il s'était imposé en finale face à son compatriote Ali Carter (11-9). Il succédait ainsi au palmarès du tournoi chinois à l'actuel numéro un mondial, Judd Trump, vainqueur en 2024. La légende Ronnie O'Sullivan est le joueur le plus titré à Shanghai. Il a remporté les Masters à cinq reprises (en 2009, 2017, 2018, 2019 et 2023).

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Suivez la Coupe du monde de cross-country, une série de courses de VTT multi-épreuves gérée par l'Union Cycliste Internationale. La première série de Coupes du monde, composée d'épreuves de cross-country, a eu lieu en 1989. La Coupe du monde de descente a été inaugurée deux ans plus tard, et celle de slalom double en 1998. Les coureurs gagnent des points en fonction de leur classement dans chaque épreuve.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Le grand favori du contre-la-montre Elite messieurs des championnats du monde de Montréal 2026 est le Belge Remco Evenepoel, en quête d'un nouveau sacre après ses trois titres consécutifs, de 2023 à 2025. Ses principaux adversaires seront l'Italien Filippo Ganna, le Britannique Joshua Tarling et le Suisse Stefan Küng. Côté français, on espère un podium pour Rémi Cavagna ou Bruno Armirail.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour de Luxembourg
programme.desc: Organisé depuis 1935, ce Tour de Luxembourg cycliste se déroule chaque année, et parcourt les différentes étapes souvent vallonées qui le compose. Depuis 2005, Škoda est le principal sponsor de la course.

programme.title: Snooker : Wuhan Open
programme.desc: Le joueur chinois de 37 ans Xiao Guodong, actuel n°11 mondial, est le double tenant du titre de l'Open de Wuhan. L'an dernier, il avait remporté le tournoi pour la deuxième année consécutive en battant l'Anglais Gary Wilson (10-9), au terme d'une finale à suspense. L'année précédente, Xiao avait décroché son premier titre classé en s'imposant (10-7) face à Si Jiahui, lors d'une finale 100 % chinoise.

programme.title: CRO Race | 1re étape
programme.desc: Retransmission des étapes du Tour de Croatie, une course professionnelle de cyclisme sur route.. La course a été créée en 1994, après avoir été une course amateur les cinq premières années de son histoire, elle devient finalement professionnelle et intègre l'UCI Europe Tour. Au programme de très belles étapes le long de la côte Adriatique.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Le contre-la-montre par équipes en relais mixte des championnats du monde 2026 se déroule à Montréal sur une distance de 40,6 km, avec un dénivelé positif de 290 mètres. Parmi les nations favorites : la France, l'Italie, la Suisse, l'Allemagne, les Pays-Bas et la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: Skoda Tour of Luxembourg
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante de las jornadas de competencia del evento Skoda Tour de Luxemburgo 2026. Los amantes deldeporte podrán disfrutar de cinco días de ciclismo profesional en ruta en el Gran Ducado de Luxemburgo. La carrera forma parte de la UCI ProSeries y atrae a equipos y ciclistas profesionales internacionales. La edición de 2026 cuenta con cinco etapas que recorren más de 700 km.

programme.title: Arctic Race of Norway
programme.desc: Cobertura de las jornadas de competición en el marco de la Carrera Ártica de Noruega 2025. El público podrá disfrutar de una carrera ciclista por etapas celebrada en la región de Nordland de Noruega, por encima del Círculo Polar Ártico. Algunos de los mejores ciclistas profesionales del mundo competirán en la carrera, que lleva a los participantes a través de impresionantes, salvajes y espectaculares paisajes noruegos.

programme.title: Czech Cycling Tour
programme.desc: Vive toda la emoción del Czech Tour en su edición del 2026. Esta carrera ciclista por etapas es la más importante de la República Checa. Ascendida a las UCI ProSeries, el evento destaca por sus desafiantes recorridos.

programme.title: 30 for 30: The New York Sack Exchange
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ First Take
programme.desc: First Take (Sports). Stephen A. Smith joins host Molly Qerim on this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979.
